instruction: Change the permissions of file 'file1' to make it executable.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: if [ -x file1 ]; then echo 'Success: file1 is executable.'; else echo 'Failure: file1 is not executable.'; fi
